title: Mermaid Lotus Offering
description: A vibrant fantasy scene shows a purple-haired mermaid with a green and yellow scaled tail emerging from turquoise ocean waters. She leans over a wooden dock where a large green bowl holds a glowing red lotus flower containing food and drink, surrounded by blue berries, a teacup, flowers, and three women in traditional attire with flower crowns.
prompt: A vibrant fantasy digital painting of a beautiful mermaid with long flowing purple hair and a shimmering green scaled tail, emerging from bright blue ocean waters near a wooden dock. She leans forward with a gentle expression, looking at a large ornate green bowl containing a glowing red lotus flower filled with food and drink, surrounded by blue berries, a teacup, pink flowers, and three women wearing flower crowns and traditional attire. The background features a colorful pixelated sky transitioning from pink to blue to green, with bubbles floating in the air, in a whimsical and detailed style.
